calculation_handling.description: In the Residential Zone category a day nursery children's play area may not be in a front yard or a side yard abutting a street.
calculation_handling.gaps: Day nursery play areas are not modelled.

calculation_handling.description: In the Residential Apartment Zone category a day nursery children's play area may be no closer to a lot line abutting a street than 6.0 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: No target for a play-area setback (street_setback_m is a building setback); the Residential Apartment zone is not in the zone vocabulary.

units.disclosure: The 6.0 m street setback for day nursery play areas in the Residential Apartment zone category is not evaluated.

150.45.50.1(1).explanation: A day nursery children's play area may not be in a front yard or a side yard abutting a street in the Residential zone category, and in the Residential Apartment zone category it may be no closer than 6.0 m to a lot line abutting a street.
